confirm.title: Duba mu'amala
confirm.demoNotice: Demo Mode: wannan shi ne wani kwaikwayo. babu blockchain canja wuri faruwa, babu wani abu da aka sanya hannu ko watsa shirye-shirye, da kuma kawai Demo walat balance a cikin wannan browser canji.
